Title: Vivienne Géroux - which text is correct ?

Messages.Author: Timo
Messages.Body:
I don't own any copy of this card because I didn't had any Berlin anthology pack.

But if you look at the online text you have :
Name: Vivienne Géroux [Anthology:LARP1] Cardtype: Ally Cost: 1 pool Unique ghoul with 2 life. 2 strength, 1 bleed. Requires an anarch. Vivienne can play cards requiring basic Celerity [cel] or Fortitude [for] as a vampire. Vampires you control get -1 stealth on political actions. A vampire you control can give control of Vivienne to another Methuselah as a (D) action. A vampire controlled by another Methuselah can steal Vivienne as a (D) action.

And if you look at the preview shown in the news for the KS you have that :

The difference stand in the "cel or for" on the first text and "cel and/or for" on the second.

So on one instance it can't play forced march and on the other it can.

Is it a modification ? or a typo in one of the 2 available texts ?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
She'll be updated at the same time as the official release of the KS.
Please note that she'll also be able to play cards requiring an Anarch.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
